title: Monotonicity of the nonhalting probability
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. The probability that a uniformly random choice word of length $t$ leaves the machine unhalted is nonincreasing in $t$: whenever $t\le t'$, the probability at length $t'$ is at most the probability at length $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output
The comparison holds for all natural numbers $t\le t'$
